items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: I suspect just watching, slow drag, Paul Vigio, I think tie his base to the top of an automobile

ctx.x: some such thing like that, I remember very...

And it was very exciting. Oh, it was a great party. It was a great big place. There were all sorts of people there, ranging from newborn to in their 80s, I suspect. Mostly kinfolk of the Gaglianos. But one of the girls in the family was an exotic or semi-exotic dancer of some sort, so she chimied or something of the sort at one point. There were great tubs of beer and food and all sorts of things, and the band played for hours and hours. Finally got away late in the evening. They were scheduled to do a broadcast.…
George was broadcasting it on WTPS at Lee Circle at one point, but I don't know, I seem to think that was Sunday afternoon or something.
